entry.summary: Westerly winds are expected to strengthen again from late Friday morning and may approach severe gale in exposed places. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

entry.summary: Snow showers are expected from later Thursday afternoon and 1 to 2 cm may accumulate about the summit at times with lesser amounts above 700 metres Thursday evening and Friday morning.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers will affect the road until Friday afternoon, but snow is only expected to accumulate on the road overnight tonight into early Friday morning. 1 or 2 cm may accumulate between midnight tonight and 8am Friday morning above 700 metres.

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow showers may affect the road at times until Friday evening, but snow is not expected to accumulate on the road until Friday morning. 1 or 2 cm may accumulate between 6 am and noon Friday, with lesser amounts down to 700 metres.
